output.best_reason: Version C has the most tension and the most natural fact delivery. Rosa cannot say what time she went up, so the clock timeline becomes a trap rather than a recital. Her account of touching the cold hand, thinking he had only fainted, and then being interrupted by the doctor and the police gives the scene a real emotional and investigative charge. Her terse, Germanic syntax ("Ja," "I did not sit down once") sounds like a working woman without tipping into pastiche.
